result.summary: The 15 filter settings you listed are now device keys (KeyType.CONFIG plus KeyType.DEVICE), so they can be set on a device or a group. FilterHandler now resolves each setting for the position's device with AttributeUtil.lookup: the device attribute first, then its groups, then the server configuration, then the key default. With nothing configured, filter.future still filters positions more than 86400 s in the future. A value of 0 or false still disables a filter. The constructor is now FilterHandler(CacheManager, StatisticsManager), and MainModule was updated to match. filter.globalDailyLimit was not in your list, so it is still server-only: it is read from cacheManager.getConfig() for each position. The full test suite passes (614 tests, 0 failures) and checkstyleMain/checkstyleTest pass, run with JDK 25 because the project needs Java 21 or newer.

changes.summary: Added KeyType.DEVICE to filter.invalid, zero, duplicate, outdated, future, past, accuracy, approximate, static, distance, maxSpeed, minPeriod, dailyLimit, dailyLimitInterval and skipLimit.

Removed the Config constructor parameter and the cached fields. Each filter now resolves its setting for the position's device through AttributeUtil.lookup; a missing value with no default means disabled (false or 0). The global daily limit is read from the server configuration for each position.
provideFilterHandler now calls new FilterHandler(cacheManager, statisticsManager).

Updated to the new constructor; the config mock now stubs getString, which is what lookup reads. The passing handler now sets filter.future=0, because the default now applies. Added testDefaultFuture (the 86400 s default) and testDeviceAndGroupSettings: the server config applies to a device without attributes; device attributes disable invalid and future filtering for that device only; a group attribute enables static filtering for its devices; a device attribute takes priority over its group.

acceptance.criterion: A filter setting on a device or group changes the filtering of that device only
acceptance.evidence: In testDeviceAndGroupSettings, device 1 (no attributes) is still filtered by the server config. Device 2 sets filter.invalid=false and filter.future=0, and its invalid and future positions pass. The group of devices 3 and 4 sets filter.static=true, so device 3 drops static positions. Device 4 sets filter.static=false on itself, which overrides the group.

acceptance.criterion: The change is covered by tests
The existing test suite still passes
acceptance.evidence: ./gradlew test checkstyleMain checkstyleTest with JAVA_HOME=openjdk@25: 614 tests, 0 failures/errors, checkstyle clean.

harness_used: Existing FilterHandlerTest and the Mockito/JUnit setup
AttributeUtil.lookup, the existing per-device lookup (already used by filter.calendar and filter.skipAttributes)

harness_gaps.problem: The repository has no agent instructions (CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md) and no note on the required JDK. The default JDK 17 fails with 'invalid source release: 21'; I had to find openjdk@25 myself.

The old test stubbed typed Config getters (getBoolean/getLong). AttributeUtil.lookup reads config.getString, so after the change those stubs had no effect and every test had to be moved to getString stubs.
